utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, bring your notes if you can—I’m sure the group will appreciate them. If you end up running late, no worries; I’ll make sure Pia has the book club details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll bring my notes for sure. I’m probably going to be a little late again, but I’ll catch up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks, Dane — we’ll catch you when you get there. I’ll pass the details along to Pia too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still planning to come by the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk. If anything changes, I’ll wait for Sam’s reminder or word from Opal.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli — I’ll keep an ear out for Sam or Opal too. And I heard Gus may send over some good book picks and help settle the meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine to me — I’ll stick with the plan for the little room by the library desk unless I hear otherwise. Clear reminders make things easier.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, that helps a lot — I’ll keep the book club time in mind and make sure we’ve got enough snacks and paper.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sounds good — can you confirm the time and place first? Then I can let Pia know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still waiting on Leo to nail down the exact meeting time, but it’s at the usual place. Once he confirms, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m still ready if we end up reading The Midnight Library or The Night Circus. If we need the details, Rosa can send them.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I read a mystery this month, so I’m happy with either one. Rosa can send the details if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, then I’m set either way. If Uli’s right and it’s The Night Circus, I’m ready for that one too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, I just need the time and the exact room details, and I should be able to make it if I can work it into my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll share the time and room details with everyone. Gus said he can help if we need anything, and maybe Uli will listen in too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that would help a lot — I’m just trying to make sure I have the time and the exact room at the community center on Maple so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center today, and there’ll be tea and pastries too. Mara’s bringing a few book suggestions, if you’re going.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m going, but I want to check which book suggestions Mara’s bringing first. Is one of them The Midnight Library?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not sure yet, but I can find out for you at the community center. If you want, I can also save you a seat by the window.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The Midnight Library still sounds like a good pick to me, but I’m open if the group has another strong choice. Can you check what everyone’s leaning toward?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week and see what everyone’s leaning toward. Vik will probably keep us all posted on the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that works for me — let me know what the group settles on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still waiting on Rosa to text the next pick. Once she does, I can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll bring a few book suggestions to the meetup at the community center, and we can pick together once Rosa texts the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, that works for me. I’m still waiting on Rosa’s text, and then we can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yep — it’s still Thursday at the community center for the book club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I can send you the exact book club details anytime. If Rosa texts the next pick, I’ll save Bo a spot too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — Thursday at the community center is still the plan, and I’ll keep an eye out for Rosa’s text about the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam can help pick the next book and send everyone a quick reminder. Gus can help nail down a meeting time and bring a few book ideas, and Cleo has an extra copy if we need it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll keep Thursday at the cafe, save Nell a spot, and text her the details. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll text Bo the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Thursday at the cafe works. Thanks for texting Nell and Bo.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thursday at the cafe works for me. I’ll keep an eye out for Quinn’s message.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The book club meets at the community center, so I’ll see you there. If we need anything, Gus can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I had Thursday at the cafe — Rosa was going to send the details. I’ll check Quinn’s message and figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, I heard book club picked a new novel for next week. Jules can send the meeting details, and Mara’s bringing a few suggestions for the next meetup too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll check with the group and see what we’re reading next. If you want, I can also bring over a few book ideas or help nail down a meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great, Gus—thanks. If you hear the meeting time, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check with the group about what we’re reading next and help pin down a meeting time, too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great, Gus—I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone. Sam can help pick the next book and send a quick reminder, and Uli might listen in too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll check with the group and see what we’re reading next, then we can pick a meeting time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The book club meets at the community center, right? If we need anything, Gus can help out, and Cleo has an extra copy of the mystery read.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so—let me just double-check the meeting details before we count on it. And if Mina’s leaning toward The Midnight Library, we should note that too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good. Just let me know once you’ve checked, and I’ll note Mina’s pick too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Gus can help lock in a meeting time and bring a few book ideas. Sam can pick the next book and send everyone a quick reminder.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll bring a few book suggestions to the meetup at the community center, and we can choose the next one together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, and Cleo has an extra copy if anyone needs one.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll help pick the next book, and I’ll send everyone a quick reminder too. I’ll make sure Tess gets Faye’s thanks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll bring my notes, though I’ll probably be a little late again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — bring your notes when you can, and we’ll get you caught up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure — I can send the exact book club details. If you want, I can also loop Nell in with them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — send the time and place first, and then I’ll let Pia know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you the time and place now, and then you can pass them along to Pia.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m still waiting on Rosa’s text for the next pick, then Jules can send the details and save me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—Thursday at the community center is still set for the book club. Once Rosa texts the next pick, Jules can send the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’m still just waiting on Rosa’s text for the pick. Then Jules can send the details and hold my spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s at the community center, and there’ll be tea and pastries too. Mara’s bringing a few book suggestions, and I can save Kira a seat by the window if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds lovely — could you save me a seat too? I’m still waiting on the exact details, but I’d love a few of the book ideas Mara’s bringing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll save you a seat by the window too. And I’ll bring you Mara’s book ideas as soon as I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m leaning toward The Midnight Library, but I’m open if the group prefers something else. Can you check what the book club is reading next?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they picked a new novel for next week, so we should be set. If you want, I can ask Jules to send the meeting details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That’d be great—please ask Jules and send me the details when you get them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send Pia the book club details so everyone’s in the loop. Cleo’s mystery, Noah’s questions, and those extra snacks should make it a fun one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, thanks for looping everyone in. I’ll catch up on the new pick before next week so I’m ready for the club.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’m glad you’ll be ready. I’ll make sure Pia gets the details, and then we’re all set for next week.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I can save Nell a spot and send the book club details. I’m checking the list now, and I’ll text Bo the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Thursday at the cafe still works for me too, and I’ll watch for Quinn’s message.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — Thursday at the cafe is still the plan. I’ll keep Nell’s spot saved and send the details along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check the school schedule and make sure we land on a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, thank you. I’ll plan on the community center on Maple unless I hear otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll confirm after I check the school calendar, and we can stick with the Maple community center for now.
